decisions.outcome: Count every Review Slice model request and permit one round-1 correction brief only
call_paths: assessAttempt -> runReview request -> review.completed -> classifyOutcome -> zero or one correction brief

before: Review failure or correction can re-enter reviewing without a per-slice request ceiling
after: Every attempted reviewer request increments an immutable round; round 1 may emit one fixable implementation correction
errors: Invalid output and reviewer infrastructure failure consume the current round and remain evidence

data_shapes: review.completed {reviewOutcomeId, workId, reviewSliceId, attemptId, round, patchDigest, status, review, usage, reviewerSessionId}
state_flow: GREEN -> review round 1 -> accepted | one correction | persisted non-fixable outcome
wiring: assessAttempt reads round projection from Work events before invoking runReview
failure_handling: Reject a third request before model launch; never convert reviewer failure into an uncounted retry
deletions: Unbounded retry-review behavior in Pair v4

tests.name: review request counting and correction cap
tests.purpose: prove at most two requests and one correction brief
tests.red_signal: current retry paths permit another request or correction

decisions.outcome: Make round 2 evidence-only and complete Work after cumulative deterministic verification without anchor or cumulative model review
call_paths: corrected GREEN -> round 2 -> persist findings -> accept slice -> final deterministic verification -> work.completed

before: Anchor sampling and final cumulative review can add model calls; round-2 findings can re-enter correction
after: Round 2 never corrects or blocks; Work completion invokes no anchor or cumulative model reviewer
errors: Final deterministic verification failure remains blocking and preserves exact resume state

data_shapes: round-two Review Outcome has remediationRequired=false and pendingHumanReview=true when findings exist
state_flow: round-1 correction -> verifying -> round-2 -> accepting; final slice -> cumulative-verification -> complete
wiring: finalizePairPlan retains finalVerificationCommands and skips runReview
failure_handling: Round-2 reviewer failure is persisted and acceptance proceeds only when deterministic verification is green
deletions: Pair v4 cumulative model review and correction loop

tests.name: two-round lifecycle and model-free completion
tests.purpose: prove corrected patch review and final deterministic gate
tests.red_signal: current lifecycle invokes cumulative review or remediates round 2

decisions.outcome: Persist immutable addressable Review Outcomes and derive restart-safe pending and all projections
call_paths: review.completed events -> projectReviewInbox -> pending/all Review Outcome projection

before: Reviews are embedded inside terminal attempts and lack stable per-request/finding identity
after: Every request and finding has deterministic stable identity and is independently queryable after restart
errors: Malformed, duplicate, digest-conflicting, or unsupported-version events fail closed without projection mutation

data_shapes: Review Outcome v1 and Review Finding v1 with stable IDs and Work/Review Slice/attempt/round/patch bindings
state_flow: append immutable review.completed -> reducer/projector rebuild -> pending until Review Feedback adjudicates all findings
wiring: review-learning reads existing per-Work events; it never creates alternate Work authority
failure_handling: Validate schema and digest bindings before appending or projecting

tests.name: restart-safe Review Inbox
tests.purpose: prove IDs, ordering, pending/all, restart, and malformed-event rejection
tests.red_signal: current attempt evidence cannot address individual requests or findings

non_goals: Copy review evidence outside repository Pair authority

decisions.outcome: Record reasoned append-only Review Feedback without rewriting Review Outcomes
call_paths: validated outcome/finding ID + judgment + reason -> review-feedback.recorded -> inbox adjudication projection

before: Human gate evidence addresses only the latest mutable review
after: useful, false-positive, unclear, and missed judgments append against stable historical IDs
errors: Unrecognized IDs, empty reasons, invalid judgments, and conflicting duplicate feedback are rejected

data_shapes: Review Feedback v1 {feedbackId, targetType, targetId, judgment, reason, recordedAt}
state_flow: pending finding -> feedback recorded -> adjudicated; historical outcome bytes unchanged
wiring: recordReviewFeedback resolves target through projectReviewInbox before append
failure_handling: Idempotent identical retries; conflicting replay fails visibly

tests.name: append-only Review Feedback
tests.purpose: prove validation, identity, idempotence, and immutable history
tests.red_signal: no repository capability records feedback against historical findings

decisions.outcome: Generate bounded Review Guidance proposals and inject only active human-approved rules
call_paths: up to eight unlearned feedback events -> one provider-affine proposal -> human decision -> active guidance projection -> reviewPrompt

before: Reviewer prompts can receive prior findings but no curated learning
after: Only approved active rules, max 20 and 4096 UTF-8 bytes, enter future prompts
errors: Malformed/oversized proposals, stale proposal IDs, or absent human decisions cannot activate rules

data_shapes: Review Guidance proposal v1 with proposalId, sourceFeedbackIds, rules[{guidanceId,text,status}] and byte count
state_flow: feedback pending-learning -> proposal pending -> approved active | rejected; active may later retire
wiring: reuse existing review runtime/session for one explicit on-demand request; reviewPrompt receives serialized active rules
failure_handling: Never retry proposal automatically; preserve feedback pending on environment or schema failure
deletions: Raw prior-review history injection as future learning

tests.name: bounded human-gated guidance proposal
tests.purpose: prove eight-item request and explicit decision lifecycle

tests.name: active guidance prompt bounds
tests.purpose: prove approval, active-only selection, count/byte limits, and injection-safe serialization
tests.red_signal: reviewPrompt has no approved bounded guidance projection

decisions.outcome: Persist optional pause policy and coalesce adjacent round-2 and task boundaries
call_paths: persist pause mode -> review/task transition -> existing pauseWork checkpoint -> resume exact pending transition

before: Pause is explicit and generic with no repository policy
after: off, review, task, both pause at defined boundaries and both emits one adjacent round-2/task pause
errors: Unsupported mode or corrupt setting fails visibly; resume never reruns persisted review

data_shapes: Pair settings v1 {pauseAfter: off|review|task|both}; pause checkpoint includes pending transition identity
state_flow: review.completed/attempt accepted -> optional work.paused -> work.resumed -> saved transition
wiring: runControl persists setting; assess/final transition consults reducer-projected policy
failure_handling: Write setting atomically and preserve prior valid mode on failure

tests.name: persistent pause modes and coalescing
tests.purpose: prove four modes, exact resume, and one adjacent pause
tests.red_signal: current loop has no automatic boundary policy

decisions.outcome: Expose a strict versioned pair-review JSON backend and install it for Claude and Codex
call_paths: Neovim argv -> installed pair-review -> strict operation -> repository projection/mutation -> JSON v1 stdout

before: No backend exists for durable review management
errors: Unsupported operation, malformed input, stale ID, non-repository cwd, or internal failure returns nonzero secret-safe JSON

data_shapes: Pair Review response v1 {schema:1, operation, ok, repository, data|error}; contract schema and representative fixture
state_flow: read operations never mutate; write operations append/atomically update then return refreshed projection
wiring: runtime asset manifest installs bin/pair-review; wrapper executes skills/pair-v3/scripts/pair-review
failure_handling: Never print raw model events, prompts, private paths, or stack traces in JSON errors

tests.name: versioned Pair Review CLI
tests.purpose: prove all operations, schema version, installation declaration, status codes, and redaction
tests.red_signal: pair-review executable and contract are absent

non_goals: Make CLI syntax the primary human interface

decisions.outcome: Align canonical review-learning vocabulary and Pair v4 documentation
call_paths: canonical vocabulary -> Pair skill guidance -> generated/runtime contract tests

before: Review Outcome, Review Feedback, and Review Guidance are undefined
after: Each term has one canonical definition and relation to Work and Review Slice
errors: Generated docs or old cumulative-review claims fail contract tests

data_shapes: Canonical glossary entries with aliases-to-avoid and relations
state_flow: approved vocabulary -> generated instructions and runbook
wiring: documentation tests enforce two-round and Neovim-primary backend wording
failure_handling: Validation fails on contradictory review-until-approved or cumulative AI-review language
deletions: Pair v4 cumulative AI review instructions

tests.name: review-learning documentation contract
tests.purpose: prove vocabulary and Pair v4 runbook alignment
tests.red_signal: current docs require cumulative review and omit new terms
